verdict.rationale: Docs confirm shared folders with inherited permissions, per-file view/comment/edit sharing controls, and a documented pattern for auditing file-sharing info into a spreadsheet, which together approximate a lightweight data room with access visibility. However, there is no explicit evidence of native download/print/copy-disable toggles for viewers, link expiration, or a built-in audit/activity log dashboard purpose-built for diligence tracking. missing for 10: explicit download/print/copy restriction feature, link expiration controls, native audit-log/activity-visibility UI (beyond a custom script).
